description_en: Queries the CIDR blocks of nodes on which Database Backup (DBS) is running
description_zh: 该接口用于查看DBS运行节点网段列表
kebab_example: aliyun dbs describe-node-cidr-list --biz-region cn-hangzhou --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNodeCidrList

parameters.description_en:
The region in which DBS is activated. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: China (Hangzhou)

- **cn-shanghai**: China (Shanghai)

- **cn-qingdao**: China (Qingdao)

- **cn-beijing**: China (Beijing)

- **cn-shenzhen**: China (Shenzhen)

- **cn-hongkong**: China (Hong Kong)

- **ap-southeast-1**: Singapore (Singapore)

- **cn-hangzhou-finance**: China East 1 Finance

- **cn-shanghai-finance**: China East 2 Finance

- **cn-shenzhen-finance**: China South 1 Finance
parameters.description_zh: DBS地域，可通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~2869853~~)接口查看DBS支持地域。
